MAKE IT YOUR RACE

READY, SET, GO.

Your first lap.

  1. You bring the steering. Your kart accelerates for you. Use the two arrow buttons to steer.
  2. Make the corners count. Hold DRIFT while turning. Fill the meter, then release for a turbo.
  3. A little surprise. Drive through floating gems. Tap ITEM to boost, shield, launch a rocket, or leave a bubble trap.

Keyboard: A/D or ←/→ to steer · Space to drift · E to use item · Esc to pause. Rotate your phone for a wider view.
